description: Phase 4 — Broker Daemon & 5-Tool MCP Surface: implement allowlist.py, secret_scrubber.py, schemas/tools.py, schemas/error.py, and broker.py. This is the MCP stdio facade that the AI coding agents connect to. Depends on FEAT-001 (package layout) and FEAT-002 (engine imports). Independent of FEAT-003/004/006.
steps: Create src/mcp_gateway/schemas/error.py at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/mcp_gateway/schemas/error.py. Implement: (a) Dataclass (frozen=True) ErrorDetail with fields: code: str, message: str, retryable: bool. (b) Dataclass (frozen=True) FailureEnvelope with fields: ok: Literal[False] = False, error: ErrorDetail. Method to_dict() -> dict[str,Any]. (c) Error code constants as module-level strings: PERMISSION_DENIED='PERMISSION_DENIED', NOT_FOUND='NOT_FOUND', ALLOWLIST_DENIED='ALLOWLIST_DENIED', AUTH_REQUIRED='AUTH_REQUIRED', UPSTREAM_DRIFT='UPSTREAM_DRIFT', MUTATION_UNKNOWN='MUTATION_UNKNOWN', VAULT_LOCKED='VAULT_LOCKED', INVALID_ARGUMENT='INVALID_ARGUMENT', INTERNAL='INTERNAL'. (d) Function make_error(code: str, message: str, retryable: bool = False) -> FailureEnvelope. Full type annotations.

Create src/mcp_gateway/schemas/tools.py at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/mcp_gateway/schemas/tools.py. Implement: (a) Python dicts representing the 5 MCP tool input schemas (JSON Schema format). Each schema has additionalProperties:false, required list, and properties. (b) LIST_NOTEBOOKS_SCHEMA: {type:object, additionalProperties:false, properties:{page_size:{type:integer, minimum:1, maximum:100, default:20}, cursor:{type:string}}}. (c) GET_NOTEBOOK_METADATA_SCHEMA: {type:object, additionalProperties:false, required:['notebook_id'], properties:{notebook_id:{type:string, minLength:1}}}. (d) LIST_SOURCES_SCHEMA: {type:object, additionalProperties:false, required:['notebook_id'], properties:{notebook_id:{type:string}, page_size:{type:integer, minimum:1, maximum:100}, cursor:{type:string}}}. (e) QUERY_NOTEBOOK_SCHEMA: {type:object, additionalProperties:false, required:['notebook_id','question','request_key'], properties:{notebook_id:{type:string}, question:{type:string, minLength:1, maxLength:2000}, request_key:{type:string, minLength:1}, source_ids:{type:array, items:{type:string}}, timeout_seconds:{type:integer, minimum:10, maximum:300, default:120}}}. (f) ADD_SOURCE_SCHEMA: {type:object, additionalProperties:false, required:['notebook_id','idempotency_key','source'], properties:{notebook_id:{type:string}, idempotency_key:{type:string}, wait_until_ready:{type:boolean, default:false}, source:{type:object, additionalProperties:false, required:['type'], properties:{type:{type:string, enum:['text','url','youtube','drive','file']}, url:{type:string}, title:{type:string}, content:{type:string}, doc_id:{type:string}, mime_type:{type:string}, upload_id:{type:string}}}}. (g) TOOL_ANNOTATIONS dict mapping each tool name to its readOnlyHint/destructiveHint/idempotentHint per code-standards.md. Full type annotations. No runtime imports of MCP SDK here — pure data.

Create src/mcp_gateway/broker/allowlist.py at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/mcp_gateway/broker/allowlist.py. Implement: (a) Dataclass AllowlistConfig with fields: version: int, provider_mode: str, accounts: list[str], notebooks: list[str]. (b) Function load_allowlist(path: Path | None = None) -> AllowlistConfig — reads from path or default ~/.config/notebooklm-mcp-bridge/allowlist.json; raises FileNotFoundError with clear message if absent; parses JSON; validates structure; returns AllowlistConfig. (c) Function save_allowlist(config: AllowlistConfig, path: Path | None = None) -> None — atomically writes using tempfile + rename. (d) Function is_notebook_allowed(config: AllowlistConfig, notebook_id: str) -> bool — returns notebook_id in config.notebooks. (e) Function add_notebook(config: AllowlistConfig, notebook_id: str) -> AllowlistConfig — returns new AllowlistConfig with notebook_id appended if not present. (f) Function remove_notebook(config: AllowlistConfig, notebook_id: str) -> AllowlistConfig — returns new config without notebook_id. All functions fully typed. Never logs notebook_id in error strings (could be derived from user data).

Create src/mcp_gateway/broker/secret_scrubber.py at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/mcp_gateway/broker/secret_scrubber.py. Implement: (a) Module-level compiled regex patterns for: SID cookie (pattern r'(?i)\bSID=[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]+'), HSID (r'(?i)\bHSID=[A-Za-z0-9_]+'), SSID (r'(?i)\bSSID=[A-Za-z0-9_]+'), __Secure-1PSID (r'(?i)__Secure-1PSID=[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]+'), SAPISID (r'(?i)\bSAPISID=[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]+'), ya29 token (r'ya29\.[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]{10,}'), SNlM0e (r'SNlM0e["\s]*[:=]["\s]*[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]+'), FdrFJe (r'FdrFJe["\s]*[:=]["\s]*[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]+'), authorization bearer (r'(?i)Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]{20,}'). (b) Function scrub(text: str) -> str — applies all patterns, replacing matches with '[REDACTED]'. (c) Function scrub_dict(obj: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] — recursively scrubs all string values in a dict. (d) Function assert_clean(text: str) -> None — raises ValueError('[SECRET DETECTED]') if scrub(text) != text. Used in unit tests. Full type annotations.

Create src/mcp_gateway/broker/broker.py at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/mcp_gateway/broker/broker.py. This is the main broker daemon. Implement: (a) OS setup at module import: os.environ['UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE'] = '3'. (b) Dataclass BrokerConfig with fields: socket_path: str = '/tmp/mcp-gemini-broker.sock', allowlist_path: Path | None = None, journal_db_path: Path | None = None, capability_secret: bytes = field(default_factory=lambda: secrets.token_bytes(32)). (c) Class BrokerDaemon: __init__(config: BrokerConfig) — loads allowlist, initializes IPC server. Async method start() -> None — creates Unix domain socket at config.socket_path, chmod 0o600, begins accepting connections. Async method handle_ipc_connection(reader, writer) — reads IPC frames (big-endian 32-bit), parses JSON command, dispatches to _dispatch(command), writes IPC response frame. Method _dispatch(command: dict[str,Any]) -> dict[str,Any] — validates notebook_id against allowlist (raises ALLOWLIST_DENIED if absent), routes to appropriate handler method, calls secret_scrubber.scrub_dict() on response before returning. Handlers: _handle_batchexecute, _handle_query_stream, _handle_scotty_upload — each forwards the already-scrubbed command JSON to native host IPC and returns the result. (d) Class McpFacade: implements the 5-tool MCP server using mcp.Server from the mcp PyPI package. Method serve_stdio() -> None — runs MCP JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout using mcp.stdio_server(). Tool handlers call BrokerDaemon methods via local IPC. Each tool handler: validates input schema, checks allowlist, calls broker, returns structured response or FailureEnvelope. (e) function main() -> None — parses CLI args (serve | mcp), creates BrokerConfig, runs appropriate mode. if __name__ == '__main__': main(). CRITICAL: broker.py must NEVER write to sys.stdout except via the MCP SDK's stdio transport. All diagnostic logs go to sys.stderr. CRITICAL: UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=3 must be set before any asyncio loop starts.

Update src/mcp_gateway/broker/__init__.py to export BrokerDaemon, McpFacade, BrokerConfig. Update src/mcp_gateway/schemas/__init__.py to export all schema dicts, FailureEnvelope, ErrorDetail, make_error.
